title: Integrations
description: Every connected service, its health and expiry, and where to add more.

empty.title: Nothing connected yet
empty.description: Connect a git host, registry or notification channel from the catalogue below.
empty.intro: Connect a git host, registry or notification channel below to get started.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, account or host

catalog.title: Add an integration
catalog.description: Each button opens the page that owns that connection.

wizard.title: Integration
wizard.description: Connect a git host, registry, notifier or cloud account.

type.label: Sink type
type.help: Where the logs are sent: an HTTP endpoint or syslog.

target_http.label: Endpoint URL
target_http.help: HTTP URL that receives the log stream.

target_syslog.label: Syslog address
target_syslog.help: Syslog address as network://host:port. Leave empty for local syslog.

header_name.label: Auth header name
header_name.help: Optional header sent with every batch, for example Authorization or X-Api-Key.

header_value.label: Auth header value
header_value.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the stored value.

enabled.label: Forwarding
enabled.help: Turn forwarding on or pause it without losing the settings.

kind.label: Channel type
kind.help: Where the alert or deploy notice is sent.

name.label: Name
name.help: Display name shown in the dashboard and the CLI.

notify_url_webhook.label: Webhook URL
notify_url_webhook.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

notify_url_email.label: Notify email address
notify_url_email.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

notify_url_ntfy.label: Topic URL
notify_url_ntfy.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

notify_url_gotify.label: Message endpoint URL
notify_url_gotify.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

pushover_user_key.label: Pushover User Key
pushover_user_key.help: Your user key from the Pushover dashboard.

pushover_api_token.label: Pushover Application API Token
pushover_api_token.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

pagerduty_routing_key.label: Integration/Routing Key
pagerduty_routing_key.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

resend_api_key.label: Resend API Key
resend_api_key.help: API key with permission to send email.

resend_to.label: Destination email address
resend_to.help: Address that receives the alert email.

resend_from.label: From address (optional)
resend_from.help: Sender on a domain you verified in Resend. Left blank, onboarding@resend.dev is used.

opsgenie_api_key.label: Opsgenie API Key
opsgenie_api_key.help: What gets sent: app name, image/tag, success or failure, and the error message on failure. Nothing else about your app.

enabled.label: Delivery
enabled.help: Send notifications here, or pause them without deleting the channel.

notify_device_login.label: Device login alerts
notify_device_login.help: Link-only notice when a CLI login is waiting for approval. The code is never included.

notify_device_login_expired.label: Expired device login alerts
notify_device_login_expired.help: Link-only notice when a pending CLI login expires unapproved. The code is never included.

provider.label: Provider
provider.help: DNS host that holds the records for your domain.

token.label: Cloudflare API token
token.help: Scoped API token with Zone:DNS:Edit permission, not the global API key.

access_key_id.label: AWS access key ID
access_key_id.help: Access key ID of an IAM user with access to the hosted zone.

secret_access_key.label: AWS secret access key
secret_access_key.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

region.label: Region (optional)
region.help: Left empty, the AWS SDK default region chain applies.

hosted_zone_id.label: Hosted zone ID (optional)
hosted_zone_id.help: Left empty, the zone is found by matching the domain.

service_account_json.label: Service account JSON key
service_account_json.help: Needs Cloud DNS admin rights. Never shown again after saving.

name.label: Name
name.help: Shown in lists and referenced by name from app.yaml.

registry_host.label: Registry host
registry_host.help: Hostname of the registry, for example ghcr.io.

username.label: Username
username.help: Account used to pull private images.

password.label: Password (or access token)
password.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

expires_at.label: Expires (optional)
expires_at.help: Only if you already know the expiry. It cannot be detected automatically.
